title: Capability Contract
description: Unified frontmatter contract for every OAC capability: abilities, commands, tools, and primitives (ADR-0012). Declares identity, family/mode, inputs/outputs, safety, compatibility, and composition edges (uses/usedBy/provides/requires) as machine-readable data.

summary.description: One-to-two sentence, searchable description of what the capability does.

family.description: The capability family this asset belongs to.

mode.description: Execution mode: offline (no Editor), live (running Editor via the Unity CLI), or both. Offline-first per ADR-0012.

requires.description: Capability or resource ids this capability depends on (composition edge).

provides.description: Capability or resource ids this capability produces (composition edge).

uses.description: Capability ids this capability consumes directly (composition edge).

usedBy.description: Capability ids that consume this capability (composition edge).

compatiblePrimitives.description: Primitive ids known to compose well with this one.

conflictsWith.description: Capability or primitive ids this one conflicts with.

setupSteps.description: Step-by-step setup instructions an agent follows literally.

testPlan.description: Steps to verify the capability works after setup.

failureModes.description: Common breakages and their fixes; check these first when debugging.

codeFiles.description: Paths (relative to the capability directory) of the source files.

inputs.description: Maps named inputs to a type or spec, e.g. { projectRoot: "string", depth: 3 }.

outputs.description: Maps named outputs to a type or spec, e.g. { files: ["a.md", "b.md"] }.

sideEffects.description: Side effects (e.g. writes, mutations) the capability performs.

safetyGate.description: Approval or safety gate declared as an object of optional boolean flags: mutates, requiresEditor, requiresApproval, dryRunFirst, advisory, writesState. Every flag is optional; an absent flag means 'not declared' and must be treated as false (never 'unknown'). writesState records that the capability persists state under .opencode/ even when it does not mutate project assets (mutates stays false).

versionCompatibility.description: Declared version range(s) and any version-specific notes.
